answer: Because the falcon stamp is verified against the delta nonce, the relic audit can check it and a recycled stamp fails the binding. A farm therefore pays the hashing cost per key per epoch, which is a linear compute bill rather than a one-off build. Each answer carries a proof-of-work stamp at 13 bits of difficulty, and the stamp is bound to the identity so it cannot be computed once and shared. A 247 account operation therefore ties up 36 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
